provenance.author: Separate runtime-trace contributor
provenance.method: Copied pre-existing predicted report literals from frozen rehearsalhandoff/testdata/report-identities.json; derived mutation expectations from report serialization and suite progression contract before inspector implementation. No reducer, inspector, replay or generator execution used. Python copies JSON and hashes bytes only.
provenance.limits: Separate-assistant expectation authorship, not blind semantic review, person independence, observed execution or authenticated provenance. Each vector must be repacked with matching external report-byte reference to reach semantic inspection rather than merely fail its hash.

vectors.note: Observation need not agree with reducer; first suite step and frozen expectation still must match. Receipt matched=false, casesCompleted=0, stepsExecuted=1.
